stories.title: spell add --dry-run reports an existing destination
stories.description: Plan-based dry run: each file line says missing, exists identical, or exists differs.
acceptanceCriteria: A dry-run over an identical existing file, a differing existing file and a missing file prints three distinct lines and writes nothing
stories.testEvidence: test/add-plan.test.ts R-294a (three distinct lines, nothing written); mutation: conflicts-never-detected and skipExisting-as-conflict each fail tests

stories.title: spell add never throws a stack trace on an existing file
stories.description: Plan before write; one clean error line naming the file and --force; exit 1; nothing written.
acceptanceCriteria: Adding over an existing file exits 1 with one error line, no stack frame, and writes nothing
stories.testEvidence: test/add-plan.test.ts R-294b (one error line naming file and --force, exit 1, nothing written, multi-file writes none); mutation M1 fails 3 tests

stories.title: skipExisting is honoured by spell add
stories.description: An existing skipExisting destination is kept, reported as kept, not recorded; a missing one is created.
acceptanceCriteria: An existing .mcp.json is kept and reported as kept, exit 0
A missing .mcp.json is created
stories.testEvidence: test/add-plan.test.ts R-294c (keep, create, force, dry-run Would keep); mutations M2/M3/M4 each fail tests

stories.title: spell add takes several names
stories.description: add <names...> in order, stop at first failure, report added and not attempted, skip installed.
acceptanceCriteria: All-success adds every name
A failure in the middle keeps earlier adds, stops, reports Added and Not attempted, exits 1
An already-installed name is skipped, not an error
stories.testEvidence: test/add-plan.test.ts R-293c (all-success, stop at first failure with Added/Not attempted, skip installed)

stories.title: spell update installs missing requires prerequisites
stories.description: Plan before the loop; install non-initOnly prerequisites with no existing destination; hash-track; report; dry-run names the same set (ARC-052).
acceptanceCriteria: A repo with a spell component but not its cited governance component ends update with it present, hash-tracked and reported
--dry-run reports the same list and writes nothing
An initOnly or already-present prerequisite is not installed and stays listed with spell add
A same-version run installs them too
stories.testEvidence: test/update-install.test.ts R-293a (5 tests: real run, dry-run set equals real set with N=4, same-version, existing destination left alone, initOnly prerequisite never planned); test/up03-a-requires.test.ts rewritten; mutation M2/M4 fail tests

stories.title: newly available components are offered in one step
stories.description: update --add-new; checkbox on a TTY; nothing without either; doctor names the command; --user refused.
acceptanceCriteria: Interactive accept installs the chosen components
Interactive decline installs nothing
--add-new installs all non-initOnly candidates
No TTY without the flag installs nothing and prints the list
doctor prints the one command and writes nothing
stories.testEvidence: test/update-install.test.ts R-293b (8 tests: --add-new, initOnly never, no flag no TTY, interactive accept/decline, dry-run set equals real set, conflict left alone, user tier refused); test/up03-a-requires.test.ts doctor check (3 tests); mutation M1/M3 fail tests

stories.title: Record the operator's acceptance of ARC-052
stories.description: Status line records the operator's chat acceptance (2026-09-29); the initOnly comment in update.ts carries the exception.
acceptanceCriteria: DECISIONS.md ARC-052 Status is Accepted with date and source
The initOnly comment in update.ts names the exception
stories.testEvidence: DECISIONS.md ARC-052 Status line and index row read Accepted, citing the operator's chat acceptance of 2026-09-29

CHANGELOG entry
check:version-bump passes
